description: §5.2 "Data-supplied stylesheets (S472)": a `<link>` whose `href` is not a static string (a cell read, a call) and whose `rel` contains `stylesheet` (any case, anywhere — `alternate STYLESHEET`, `preload stylesheet`, either attribute order), holds a `&` (a character reference: `stylesheet`), or is itself computed, is refused — seven links, seven reports. impl#1 emits it under the S479 carve-out 2 (ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S479-3B-rest-item-21, gap g-impl1-svg-css-url-attr-and-link-stylesheet-href-unguarded-s473); before it, impl#1 compiled every one clean.
rationale: §5.2: "A `<link>` (tag compared case-insensitively) whose `href` (any case) is not a static string — `href=@u`, `href=(…)`, `href=name`, a call, … — and whose `rel` contains the text `stylesheet` (ASCII case-insensitive, anywhere in the value …) or is not a static string (`rel=@r`, `rel=(…)`) SHALL be a compile error (E-ATTR-STYLESHEET-HREF)." "A static `rel` whose text holds a `&` … is judged as not static."
